system.description:
You create an aura of Earth Release chakra that permeates your body for the duration. This chakra acts as a breastplate of steel like material.

For the duration your AC is Calculated as 13 + Your Intelligence (Or Constitution) + Half of your proficiency bonus, and you have 2 DR. This jutsu ends if you dismiss it as a Bonus action.

You cannot gain the benefit of this jutsu if you are wearing Armor and This jutsu’s effects end when you complete a short rest.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you gain +2 DR (damage reduction). If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the AC this Jutsu grants by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you gain an additional +2 DR (For a total bonus of +4). If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the AC this Jutsu grants by +2, instead of +1.
